newsitem.title: USA: Hoenig names Robert Barbera chief economist.
newsitem.headline: Hoenig names Robert Barbera chief economist.

text.p: Hoenig Group Inc said Monday that Robert Barbera has become executive vice president and chief economist for its subsidiary, Hoenig & Co Inc.

Barbera earned a wide institutional following during a dozen years as a Wall Street economist. He served as chief economist and director of economic research at Lehman Brothers and prior to that was chief economist at E.F. Hutton.
For the last two years he was co-chairman of Capital Investments International, a New York-based research company, Hoenig said.
